BRACE 2/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Quads
SECONDARY
Hip Flexors

Instructions

Preparation: Sit in the machine, adjust the pad so it sits on your shins, just above the ankle.

1

Keep your back supported and hips seated.

2

Brace your torso and grip the handles.

3

Straighten your legs and squeeze your quads.

4

Keep your hips down and hands gripping.

5

Bend your knees slowly; control the resistance.

6

Return to bent knees without losing control.

Watch out

Slamming to lockout and dropping the weight. Squeeze for a beat at the top, then lower under control.
